build_dataset_reader: build a TFRecord dataset reader for multi-dSprites with binarized variant and gzip compression
create_feature_descriptions: create feature descriptions dictionary for multi-dSprites dataset with 4 entities and grayscale images
run_dataset_tfrecords: run the dataset function to read and parse multi-dSprites TFRecords from a given path
test_decode_example: test the _decode function to parse and decode a single TFRecord example proto into tensors
review_feature_descriptions: review the feature_descriptions function to generate tf.Example-compatible shape and type descriptors
